description: Runs independent adversarial review rounds with fresh internal subagents that attack artifact assumptions, happy paths, usability, ease of use, ease of understanding, failure scenarios, and evidence gaps through formal /vs_review/ reports and mandatory response closure.

changes: Make user-perspective usability, ease of use, and ease of understanding explicit review requirements.
Add a user-experience-adversary reviewer role and selection rule for user-facing workflows, docs, skills, prompts, and operator procedures.
Extend the review report template with user-perspective focus and usability/comprehension lenses.
Add a sanity check that prevents the explicit user-perspective review contract from being removed silently.
